issues.issue: Does the claimant have a well-founded fear of persecution in China as a Christian house-church member, given that authorities are not shown to be seeking her?
issues.applicant_position: Police searched her home in 2007 over the underground church and flyers, church members were arrested, and she fears persecution if returned.
issues.respondent_position: Counsel gave an Australian decision granting protection to a Fujian citizen; panel said it is not bound.
issues.result_text: Panel determines church members were not arrested and authorities are not seeking the claimant in Fujian province.
